speaker: Penny
text: Oh, thank you very much. Come back soon. Get the other half of my tip. Hey, Sheldon, what are you doing here?

speaker: Sheldon
text: What got him so upset? Oh, sure. You can tell when Sheldon's upset. This is a restaurant. It's lunchtime. I would think as a waitress you'd be familiar with the paradigm.

speaker: Penny
text: Is Leonard coming?

speaker: Sheldon
text: No. I believe Leonard is waiting for you to come crawling back to him and apologize. I assume that would be your attitude, hence my true purpose in coming here. I want you to crawl back to him and apologize.

speaker: Penny
text: Well, that's not gonna happen.

speaker: Penny
text: Which is?

speaker: Penny
text: I'm busy.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Excuse me, miss. I'd like to order lunch.

speaker: Penny
text: Fine. What do you want?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I have a few questions. First, I noticed that you offer soup and a half sandwich. Where exactly does the half sandwich come from? Are you giving me half of someone else's sandwich? Or do I have to wait for someone else in the restaurant to order the other half?

speaker: Penny
text: No, no, Sheldon, they just make a half sandwich.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You can't make a half sandwich. It is not half of a whole sandwich. It's just a small sandwich.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, fine. It's soup and a small sandwich. Is that what you want?

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, of course not. I'll have my usual.

speaker: Penny
text: Great.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Aren't you going to ask me if I want a beverage?

speaker: Penny
text: Don't you usually get lemonade? You want lemonade? Anything else?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes, I want you to apologize to Leonard.

speaker: Penny
text: I am not going to apologize. I've done nothing wrong. He is completely overreacting.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Irrelevant? The disruption in your relationship is making my life intolerable.

speaker: Penny
text: Well, I'm sorry, Sheldon, but this really isn't about you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I don't follow.

speaker: Penny
text: Yeah, yeah, I'll be right there. Look, Sheldon, I have to go.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Let's assume, ad arguendam, that in this case, Leonard is wrong. Considering the number of transgressions you've committed that he's overlooked, don't you think that just this once you could return the favor?

speaker: Penny
text: Leonard is wrong.

speaker: Penny
text: I'm coming. Goodbye, Sheldon.
